card.name: Spots where the word safety comes next
card.fires_on: Positions in drug-label text where a safety-related word such as safe, safely or safety is likely to come next, often just before or inside a heading or phrase about safety or tolerability.

modes.label: Before a safety heading
modes.description: Inside or just after a heading like MRI Safety Information, where the next word is Safety.
modes.example: 5.10 Magnetic Resonance Imaging (<<MRI>>) Safety Information Non-clinical testing

modes.label: Partway through medical terms in safety contexts
modes.description: Inside long medical words or linking words in passages on risks, limits or adverse events.
modes.example: To serve as a warning of unintended intr<<av>>ascular or intrathecal injection,

modes.label: Safe and effective phrasing
modes.description: On the word safe itself in statements about whether treatments are safe and effective.
modes.example: Clinical trials are designed to find out whether new treatments are<< safe>> and effective.

card.writes: It pushes the model to say safe, safely or safety next, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up where a label is about to talk about safety.
